xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-2713: Deploy is missing from the Definition of Done — merged dashboard/server changes run stale until someone remembers pan reload

plan.title: Deploy is missing from the Definition of Done — merged dashboard/server changes run stale until someone remembers pan reload
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5

narratives.Problem: Merged dashboard/server changes run stale in production until someone manually rebuilds and restarts. A per-merge deploy (Step 0 of postMergeLifecycle → scripts/post-merge-deploy.sh) exists but is event-driven with no reconciliation: it is skipped by the close-out guard (verified live: 'PAN-2684 is closed out (spec completed) — skipping post-merge lifecycle'), by every skipDeploy:true reconciliation caller, and by merges whose lifecycle ran on a since-dead server. Nothing detects the resulting staleness — no build commit is stamped anywhere and /api/health reports only {status, repoRoot, mode} — so a missed deploy stays missed until an operator asks.
narratives.Proposal: Make deploy a mechanically owned DoD step in two complementary pieces. Visibility: stamp the build commit into the server/deacon bundles at build time (tsdown define), expose it on /api/health, compute 'behind origin/main by N commits touching build inputs' in a shared staleness module, surface it on /api/system/health and as a header chip. Mechanics: a deploy-window guard (verification running / merge specialist live / pending post-merge / restart lock / pan dev) plus a debounced deacon staleness patrol that spawns the bundled `pan reload --health-timeout 120000` detached as the reconciliation backstop; gate the existing Step 0 on the same staleness + guard so safe merges still deploy immediately while unsafe or unnecessary restarts fall through to the in-process lifecycle. Config deploy.auto_deploy (default true) and deploy.debounce_minutes (default 5).
narratives.NonGoals:
- No external/CI deployment or release-engine changes (triggerPostMergeReleaseIfConfigured untouched).
- No auto-deploy for projects other than the overdeck repo the server runs from.
- No removal or restructuring of Step 0 / pending-post-merge.json / processPendingLifecycle machinery, and no changes to the PAN-328 idempotency guards.
- No change to flywheel doctrine or authority (it remains the deployer when running).
- No auto-close-out or automation of other DoD rows (PAN-2715 owns the gate).
- No fix for pre-existing orphaned/duplicate dashboard server processes (PAN-2318 territory).

autoDecisions.summary: Reconciliation patrol over more event hooks: the mechanical deploy is a deacon patrol comparing the running build commit to origin/main.
autoDecisions.rationale: Root cause shows event hooks provably miss paths (close-out guard, skipDeploy reconcilers, dead-server lifecycles); a state-based patrol catches all of them by construction.

autoDecisions.summary: Build commit stamped via tsdown define in both server and root configs, with a dist/build-info.json build-step fallback if define replacement fails.
autoDecisions.rationale: Define embeds the stamp inside the bundle so it survives the atomic dist swap; typeof-guarded accessor keeps unbundled runs (vitest/tsx) safe.

autoDecisions.summary: Patrol deploys by spawning the bundled `pan reload --health-timeout 120000` detached rather than generalizing scripts/post-merge-deploy.sh.
autoDecisions.rationale: pan reload already owns the restart lock, pan-dev SIGUSR2 hot path, pristine origin/main worktree build, dist swap, and identity-checked health gate — one deploy door instead of two.

autoDecisions.summary: Step 0 changes are gating-only; skipped deploys fall through to the existing in-process lifecycle path.
autoDecisions.rationale: That path is exercised daily by every skipDeploy:true caller; restructuring the delicate PAN-328/PAN-1723 machinery is unnecessary risk.

autoDecisions.summary: Debounce = origin/main quiet period (newest commit older than deploy.debounce_minutes, default 5).
autoDecisions.rationale: A merge train keeps resetting the clock, yielding exactly one deploy after the train settles — the issue's stated requirement.
The mechanical path exists to cover flywheel-down periods; collisions with a running flywheel are harmless (restart lock + staleness re-check). auto_deploy:false keeps detection-only mode.

autoDecisions.summary: Staleness 'unknown' (unstamped legacy dist) preserves today's Step 0 deploy behavior.
autoDecisions.rationale: The first deployment of this feature must not be blocked by its own missing stamp.

items.title: Stamp build commit into bundles and expose it on /api/health

verify_commands: npm run build && node -e "const s=require('node:child_process').execSync;const out=s('grep -c \"__OVERDECK\" dist/dashboard/server.js || true').toString();process.exit(0)"
expected_outputs: build-info.test.ts passes: getBuildInfo() returns nulls when globals are undefined
after npm run build, GET /api/health on a booted dist returns buildCommit equal to git rev-parse HEAD of the build checkout

narrative.Action: Per PRD W1/D2: add define: { __OVERDECK_BUILD_COMMIT__, __OVERDECK_BUILD_TIME__ } to BOTH src/dashboard/server/tsdown.config.ts and the root tsdown.config.ts, computed at config-eval time with sync git (build-time only — the no-execSync rule applies to server-reachable code, not build configs). Create src/lib/deploy/build-info.ts exporting getBuildInfo(): { buildCommit: string|null, builtAt: string|null } with typeof guards (declare const; unstamped runs return nulls, no ReferenceError). Spread getBuildInfo() into getDashboardIdentity() (src/dashboard/server/identity.ts:16-21); /api/health (server.ts:113-119) already spreads identity so no route change. Implementation checkpoint: if tsdown define does not replace the identifiers, fall back to a build step writing dist/build-info.json read once at module init (readFileSync at module scope is acceptable — one-time, not per-request).

items.title: Given a checkout, when npm run build runs, then dist/dashboard/server.js embeds the checkout's git rev-parse HEAD and a booted server returns it as buildCommit on GET /api/health
getBuildInfo() returns { buildCommit: null, builtAt: null } without throwing when the build-time globals are undefined (vitest/tsx runs)
GET /api/health preserves the existing status/repoRoot/mode fields and additionally returns builtAt as a build-time ISO timestamp on stamped bundles
Shared build-staleness module (behind origin/main by N, filtered to build inputs)

narrative.Action: Per PRD W2: create src/lib/deploy/staleness.ts exporting BUILD_INPUT_PATHS = ['src','packages','package.json','bun.lock','tsdown.config.ts'] and computeBuildStaleness({ repoRoot, buildCommit, exec?, fetchMinIntervalMs? }) → BuildStaleness { status: 'fresh'|'stale'|'unknown', buildCommit, originMainSha, behindTotal, behindBuildInputs, originMainLastCommitAt (epoch ms), computedAt, reason? }. Mechanics: module-level throttled `git fetch origin main` (default min interval 120000 ms; failure degrades to last-fetched refs, never rejects); `git rev-parse origin/main`; `git rev-list --count <buildCommit>..origin/main` total and with `-- <BUILD_INPUT_PATHS>`; `git log -1 --format=%ct origin/main`. buildCommit null or unknown to the repo → status 'unknown' with reason. ALL exec promisified async (no execSync — server-reachable code). Export _resetForTests() for the throttle. Tests use injected exec and vi.useFakeTimers().

items.title: Given origin/main has N commits touching BUILD_INPUT_PATHS after buildCommit, computeBuildStaleness returns status 'stale' with behindBuildInputs === N and behindTotal >= N
Given buildCommit contains origin/main, computeBuildStaleness returns status 'fresh' with behindBuildInputs === 0
Given buildCommit is null or unknown to the repo, computeBuildStaleness returns status 'unknown' with a populated reason and does not reject
A second call within fetchMinIntervalMs skips git fetch (verified via injected exec call log under fake timers) and still returns counts from local refs
A git fetch failure degrades to computing against the last-fetched origin/main and returns a result instead of rejecting

narrative.Action: Per PRD W3: add deployStaleness: BuildStaleness | null to SystemHealthSnapshot (src/dashboard/server/services/system-health-service.ts:110) and populate it in getSystemHealthSnapshot (:748) using getDashboardIdentity().repoRoot + getBuildInfo().buildCommit, cached in the service with a 60s TTL (the frontend polls /api/system/health every 15s). Any staleness error is caught and yields deployStaleness: null — the snapshot must never fail because of git. Mirror the field on the frontend SystemHealthSnapshot type (follow where the existing snapshot type lives for useSystemHealth).

Header chip: 'build stale ×N' when the running build is behind on build inputs

expected_outputs: StaleBuildChip.test.tsx passes: renders stale state, renders nothing for fresh/unknown/null

narrative.Action: Per PRD W4: create StaleBuildChip.tsx modeled on SystemHealthPill.tsx (src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/SystemHealthPill.tsx:121) reading deployStaleness via useSystemHealth(). Render NOTHING unless deployStaleness?.status === 'stale' && behindBuildInputs >= 1; otherwise render text 'build stale ×N' in the warning tone with a title tooltip naming the short build commit, short origin/main commit, and behindTotal. Mount in AppChrome.tsx beside <SystemHealthPill /> (:219). Follow /pan-style-guide: color is signal only, no pill badges, monospace-leaning; no click action in this issue. Browser verification (test role) must use an isolated Playwright browser instance/profile and assert conditionally on the API's reported staleness — the chip is legitimately absent on a fresh deploy.

items.title: Renders 'build stale ×N' in the warning tone when deployStaleness.status === 'stale' and behindBuildInputs >= 1
Renders nothing when deployStaleness is null or its status is 'fresh' or 'unknown'
The chip shows the short build commit and short origin/main commit in its title/tooltip
getDeployBlockReason(): the shared deploy safety-window guard

expected_outputs: deploy-window.test.ts passes covering all five block reasons and the all-clear case

narrative.Action: Per PRD W5/D8: create src/lib/deploy/deploy-window.ts exporting getDeployBlockReason(deps?): Promise<string | null> with injectable deps. Ordered checks, first match wins, human-readable reasons (operator-facing sentences): (1) 'verification in flight for <issueIds>' — any review-status row with verificationStatus === 'running' via the review-status read door (loadReviewStatuses); (2) 'merge specialist session active' — isMergeAgentRunning() from src/lib/cloister/merge-agent.ts:1119; (3) 'post-merge lifecycle pending' — ~/.overdeck/pending-post-merge.json exists; (4) 'restart already in progress (pid N, caller)' — readRestartLockHolder() (src/lib/restart-lock.ts:150) non-null; (5) 'pan dev session owns the dashboard' — readDevSupervisorMarker() (src/lib/dev-supervisor.ts) non-null. Returns null when all clear. Async fs/exec only.

items.title: Returns a verification block reason naming the issue ids when any review-status row has verificationStatus === 'running'
Returns a merge block reason when isMergeAgentRunning() is true or pending-post-merge.json exists
Returns a restart-lock block reason when readRestartLockHolder() reports a holder, and a dev-session reason when the pan dev supervisor marker exists
Returns null when no verification is running, no merge is active, no pending file exists, the restart lock is free, and no dev supervisor marker exists
Deacon staleness patrol: observe, debounce, and auto-deploy via detached pan reload

expected_outputs: deploy-patrol.test.ts passes all decision-path cases under fake timers

narrative.Action: Per PRD W6/D3/D5/D7: (1) add deploy: { auto_deploy: boolean, debounce_minutes: number } to CloisterConfig (src/lib/cloister/config.ts:330) with defaults { auto_deploy: true, debounce_minutes: 5 } in DEFAULT_CLOISTER_CONFIG (:354). (2) Create src/lib/cloister/deploy-patrol.ts exporting runDeployPatrol(ctx) with injectable deps (computeStaleness, getBlockReason, spawnReload, emitEntry, emitTts, config, now). (3) Call it from runPatrol() in deacon.ts following the sibling pattern at :2895-2897, on a sub-cadence of every 5th patrol cycle (~5 min at the 60s patrolIntervalMs). Decision flow per run: compute staleness for the deacon's own repo root + getBuildInfo().buildCommit; 'unknown' → log once and return; 'fresh' → clear module state and return; 'stale' → emit a THROTTLED activity observation via emitActivityEntrySync (src/lib/activity-logger.ts:109) — on first detection, then at most every 30 min or when N changes — with an operator-facing sentence stating N, the short shas, and what happens next; if !auto_deploy return (signal-only); if originMainLastCommitAt is younger than debounce_minutes return (merge train settling); if getDeployBlockReason() non-null emit a throttled deferral entry naming the reason and return; otherwise spawn detached `node <repoRoot>/dist/cli/index.js reload --health-timeout 120000` (process.execPath, detached: true, stdio to an appended fd on ~/.overdeck/logs/auto-deploy.log, unref()) — the CLI path per package.json bin (pan → ./dist/cli/index.js) — emit an activity entry plus emitActivityTtsSync announcement, record lastDeploySpawnAt in module state, and skip further spawns for 10 minutes. Implementation checkpoint (D3): pan reload does not write dashboard-restarting.json (src/dashboard/server/pending-lifecycle.ts:20); if boot reconciliation flags the restart as unplanned, write that RESTART_MARKER with reason 'auto-deploy' before spawning. All timing tests use vi.useFakeTimers().

items.title: Given status 'stale', quiet origin/main (older than debounce_minutes), a null block reason, and auto_deploy true, the patrol spawns exactly one detached reload with --health-timeout 120000 and emits an activity entry and a TTS announcement
Given getDeployBlockReason returns a reason, the patrol spawns nothing and emits a throttled deferral entry containing that reason
Given the newest origin/main commit is younger than debounce_minutes, the patrol defers without spawning (verified with fake timers)
Given auto_deploy is false, the patrol emits the staleness observation but never spawns a reload
Given a reload was spawned less than 10 minutes ago, a second patrol run spawns nothing; 'fresh' and 'unknown' statuses likewise trigger no reload and no repeated observation
Gate postMergeLifecycle Step 0 on staleness and the deploy window

expected_outputs: step0 gating tests pass all four branch cases

narrative.Action: Per PRD W7/D4: inside postMergeLifecycle's `if (!options?.skipDeploy)` block (src/lib/cloister/merge-agent.ts:378-426), hoist the existing repoRoot resolution (:387-397) above new checks, then before writing the pending file: compute staleness (dynamic import of ../deploy/staleness.js with getBuildInfo().buildCommit); if status 'fresh' → log 'Running build already contains origin/main build inputs — skipping deploy restart' and fall through to the in-process lifecycle; else if status 'stale' and getDeployBlockReason() returns a reason → log 'Deploy window unsafe (<reason>) — deferring deploy to the staleness patrol' and fall through; else (stale+clear, or 'unknown' to preserve today's behavior for unstamped legacy dists) → existing pending-file write + detached spawn + return, byte-for-byte unchanged. Do NOT touch _completedPostMerge, _postMergeInFlight, Guard 2, verifyMergedBeforeLifecycle, or processPendingLifecycle. tests/unit/lib/cloister/in-flight-guard.test.ts must stay green. Deliberate side effect to assert in a test: a non-overdeck project merge with a fresh overdeck build no longer restarts the dashboard.

items.title: Given staleness 'fresh', Step 0 skips the deploy spawn and the in-process lifecycle steps still execute (labels, verifying_on_main transition, agent pause)
Given staleness 'stale' and a non-null block reason, Step 0 skips the spawn, logs the reason, and the in-process lifecycle proceeds
Given staleness 'stale' and a null block reason, Step 0 writes pending-post-merge.json, spawns the deploy script detached, and returns before the in-process steps (existing behavior preserved)
Given staleness 'unknown', Step 0 preserves today's behavior and spawns the deploy script
